model: tau_yaw = I_eff * yaw_acceleration + d_linear * yaw_rate + d_quadratic * abs(yaw_rate) * yaw_rate + bias

method.input: seven existing single-horizontal-motor +/-0.10 open-loop records; active and one-second neutral-after portions
method.force_reconstruction: current measured signed RPM inserted into historical FinsSim V4 Pro1 load-cell signed-quadratic curves
method.moment_reconstruction: tau_yaw = (r_x * d_y - r_y * d_x) * force, using the Unity/CAD 45-degree geometry prior converted to FRD
method.fit: nonnegative bounded least squares on the dynamics integrated over overlapping 0.50 s windows; bias unconstrained

excluded_file.name: v5_motor_M7_negative_010_rpm_20260811_final.csv
excluded_file.reason: gyro_z was exactly 0.088800244 rad/s in 106 of 117 active/neutral-after rows, so this record cannot support yaw dynamics fitting

geometry_status: These Unity-prefab moment arms were superseded by the exact V4 main-assembly STEP extraction on 2026-08-11; retain this fit only as historical analysis and recompute after center-of-mass confirmation.

robustness.quadratic_term_note: the nonnegative fit stayed at zero in this low-rate data; this does not establish that quadratic damping is physically zero

control_use: forbidden until current geometry and force scale are physically confirmed and a dedicated bidirectional yaw test is repeated
